title: fix(cli)!: the JSX page gate's console manifest fallback resolves through @objectstack/console/package.json, so a project without its own manifest gets full component checking
body:
Fixes #19922
Clause-②: no

## What this changes

`resolveSduiManifest()` (`packages/cli/src/utils/sdui-manifest.ts`) is the one resolver `os validate`, `os compile` / `os build` (which `os dev` and `os start` run first) and `os lint` use to arm the JSX page gate. Its second place to look, the copy `@objectstack/console` ships as `dist/sdui.manifest.json`, asked Node for that file by its own subpath. The console's `exports` map publishes `./package.json` alone, so the resolve threw `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`, a `catch` swallowed it, and every project with no `sdui.manifest.json` of its own had its `kind: 'html'` pages checked at parse level only, even where the console shipped the file.

The fallback now resolves `@objectstack/console/package.json` from the CLI's own location (`import.meta.url`, the CLI's declared dependency in the same fixed release group) and joins `dist/sdui.manifest.json` to its directory, through a new `consoleSduiManifestPath(origin)`. The console's `exports` stays closed. `resolveSduiManifest(cwd, consoleOrigin)` gains an optional origin, used only by the pins.

The old module header handed one decision to whoever made this leg reachable: what a broken shipped copy should do. It now gets the project leg's rule. A shipped copy that is present but cannot be read or parsed is `unusable` (new `source: 'console'`), and the command is refused with exit 1, naming the file, with the remedy "reinstall @objectstack/console". It is never read as "not found". With no page to check it is read by nothing and not refused, the same as the project leg.

## Premise and hypotheses, measured

All readings are on this branch over `origin/main` `f11b5f20a2`, Node v26.7.0, macOS.

- **H0 (premise holds).** On unmodified `f11b5f20a2`, a real `os init` project with one `kind: 'html'` page whose root is a `div` passes `os validate`, `os compile` and `os lint` at exit 0. Each prints only the parse-level notice, and the notice says there is no manifest at `@objectstack/console/dist/sdui.manifest.json`. It says so even while a copy of the tracked manifest sits at `packages/console/dist/sdui.manifest.json` (the stand-in's bytes are `cmp`-identical to the tracked root file, which is what `build-console.sh` copies in). From `packages/cli/dist`, `createRequire(...).resolve` of the old subpath threw `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED`, and `@objectstack/console/package.json` resolved to `packages/console/package.json`.
- **H1 (the route finds the file in both layouts).**
  - Workspace: `consoleSduiManifestPath()` from `packages/cli/dist` answered `packages/console/dist/sdui.manifest.json`.
  - Installed package: `npm pack` of `packages/console` with a stand-in dist listed `CHANGELOG.md, README.md, dist/index.html, dist/sdui.manifest.json, package.json`. Extracted under a scratch `node_modules/@objectstack/console`, the old subpath threw `ERR_PACKAGE_PATH_NOT_EXPORTED` from a sibling CLI origin, while `resolveSduiManifest` answered `resolved` with 107 components. The unit pins drive the same layout with the REAL console `package.json`.
- **H2 (Clause-② measurement: narrowing).** Before the fix, nothing refused `div` for a manifest-less customer project:
  - the CLI gate ran at parse level (H0);
  - the runtime save gate (`runtime-authoring-gate.ts`) is handed no `sduiManifest` by any host (`git grep` over `packages`);
  - `@objectstack/lint` is `@objectstack/sdui-parser`'s only consumer;
  - the renderer registers `div` as deprecated (ruling A on #20112).

  After the fix, with the console copy present, the same project goes from exit 0 to exit 1 on all three commands. Each reports `jsx-forbidden-tag` ("is not an allowed component") and `jsx-unknown-component` for the `div`. Rewriting the `div` to `box` gives exit 0 on all three, with zero JSX findings. With no console copy, all three still exit 0 with the notice, which now names the absolute console path it looked at. ⚠️ The hypothesis's "refused with ruling A's message naming `box`" is falsified: the refusal text comes from `@objectstack/sdui-parser` and does not name `box`. The changeset's migration table carries `box` instead (see Acceptance notes).
  - **CLI fixtures the live fallback newly refuses:** measured by running the four CLI test files that carry an html page, with the console copy present, at `f61057cc9e` (fix, old fixtures). 23 tests went red across three files: `build-json-failure-conversions.e2e` (5), `validate-json-failure-conversions.e2e` (4) and `jsx-gate-manifest-notice.e2e` (14). `lint-conversion-notices.e2e` stayed green, but its fixture page is refused too. The three conversion fixtures move from `div` to `box`. The notice file's 14 cases need no manifest reachable at all, so they are skipped by name where the CLI's own console copy exists: a built console, as on a developer machine. They are never skipped in the CI job that runs them, which builds no console. Every rule they pin is also pinned hermetically in `src/utils/sdui-manifest.test.ts`.
  - **Examples:** only `examples/app-showcase` carries html pages (three). No other example or scaffold template does.
- **H3 (shipped pages stay clean).** `validate-jsx-pages.production-witness.test.ts`: 5/5 pass, including "wired run over the three shipped html pages is clean". End to end, with the console copy present, `examples/app-showcase` answers exit 0 on `os validate` / `os compile` / `os lint` with zero `jsx-*` / `sdui/*` findings and no notice. That is 0 against the 200 the earlier round measured before the pages moved to `box`.
- **H4 (ablation).** Details are in Tests below.

## Changesets: two named gaps for the seat

1. **`.changeset/19922-console-manifest-fallback.md`**: `@objectstack/cli` `minor`, `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, BREAKING, with a FROM → TO table (`div` to `box`). Its ADR-0087 marker names `registered ui-html-page-div-refused`, and **that entry does not exist**: `check:adr-0087-registration` is red with "1 of those id(s) do not exist in the ADR-0087 registries at HEAD".
   - The gate refuses `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` on a body that carries a migration table. Measured: my first draft carried that marker, and the gate named the table as evidence.
   - The precedent for a page-source vocabulary narrowing is a semantic ledger entry: `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/18.ui-react-list-view-binding-aliases-retired.ts`.
   - That entry lives under `packages/spec/**`, which this dispatch keeps read-only, so it is not written here. The id is a proposal: the spec seat writes the entry, or rules a different disposition. Until then this PR cannot land.
2. **`.changeset/sdui-manifest-one-producer.md`** (pending, unreleased): a **deliberate correction**. Its last paragraph said the CLI fallback "catches the error and keeps parse-level validation, as before". That is false from this merge on. It now says to read the file the way the CLI fallback does, through `@objectstack/console/package.json` plus a join. `check-empty-changeset` is red by design here ("DELIBERATE CORRECTION ... say so on the PR and get it confirmed"). This line is that statement, and the correction needs confirming. Restoring the old text would republish a false sentence.

## Tests

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli exec vitest run --project unit --maxWorkers=2 src/utils/sdui-manifest.test.ts` at `d9dc0be3ed`: 40/40 pass. Six new or rewritten pins:
  - the CLI's own console dependency is located through its `package.json`, whether or not it is built;
  - `resolved` from a real installed layout;
  - the project manifest is read first;
  - `absent` names the absolute console path;
  - a damaged shipped copy is `unusable` / `source: 'console'`, refused with the package remedy;
  - the no-console `absent` spelling.

  Hermetic under pnpm: the `.bin` shim exports a NODE_PATH that carries the virtual store's hoisted `@objectstack/console`, so an origin in an empty tmp dir still resolved the workspace console. The no-console case therefore uses an origin `createRequire` refuses.
- Whole CLI `unit` project (`--project unit --maxWorkers=2`) at `76284b1745`: 232/234 files pass, 3342/3347 tests. The 5 failures are `published-subpath-console.pin` and `published-subpath-hook-body.pin`: `/var` against `/private/var` on macOS, where tmpdir is a symlink. They pass 29/29 with a real-path `TMPDIR`, and they touch nothing in this diff. `.changeset` files are the only change since that run.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/cli typecheck` (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck` over `tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0. `--listFiles` shows the four e2e files in the test program, and `sdui-manifest.test.ts` is under the `src` include.
- Integration layer: the four touched `*.e2e` files (nightly tier, `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly --project integration`) at `76284b1745`. With the console copy present: 53 passed, 14 skipped. Without it (CI state): 67/67 passed. The rest of the integration layer is declared to CI.
- **Ablation (H4)**, through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` (WRAP mode): the anchor `resolve(CONSOLE_PACKAGE_JSON)` hit 1 → 0, the replacement `resolve(CONSOLE_SDUI_MANIFEST)` (the old subpath) 0 → 1, and the blob went `be1f8d4ad33e` → `69b8f26fbfb0`.
  - Result: 4 of the console-leg pins go red, the first with "expected undefined to be defined".
  - Restore: the blob is back at the HEAD blob `be1f8d4ad33e`, `git diff HEAD` is empty, and the rerun at `d9dc0be3ed` passes 40/40.
  - No build: the pins import the subject relatively from `src/`, so no `dist/` sits on the measured path.

## Gates, at `d9dc0be3ed`

- `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands`: 63 derived. All 63 ran, and `--ran` reconciled "63 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 63 recorded an exit code)". 61 exit 0. Two exit 1, both the named gaps above: `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main` and `check-empty-changeset --base origin/main`. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET, then exit 0 after building its eight missing packages.
- Roster rows that could apply, all exit 0: `check-changeset-fixed`, `check-sdui-manifest` (plus `--self-test`), `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:cli-examples-parity`, `check:published-readme-exports`, `check:scaffold-emission-policy`, `check:console-injection`. No error code is stamped, so `check:error-code-provenance` is not owed: `SduiManifestRefusalError` still carries no `code`.
- `pnpm lint` (the lane's addition, full repo, not narrowed): exit 0, no output, 29s.
- `node scripts/check-issue-citations.mjs --base origin/main`: exit 0. `origin/main` is still `f11b5f20a2`, so there was nothing to merge.
- `check:nul-bytes`: exit 0, plus a control-byte scan of all 8 changed files: 0.

**Declared narrowing — verification ran UNLOCKED.** `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh`
could not take the shared verify lock on this host: no usable `flock`. The shared
verify lock is declared Linux-only (`flock` is util-linux, and a stock macOS does
not ship it), so the command below was run directly, without the lock —
a declared narrowing, not a silent one. No serialization guarantee held for this
run, nor for any sibling agent in this container while it ran.

    every build, test, typecheck, ablation and `pnpm lint` command named above

## Acceptance notes

- **The refusal does not name `box`.** For a `div` the gate answers "is not an allowed component" / "is not a known component", with the hint "fix the JSX". The text comes from `@objectstack/sdui-parser` (`parse.ts`), which is read-only here and in flight on #20112. The FROM → TO table in the changeset carries `box`. A prescription in the refusal itself belongs to that card's port. Noted, not filed.
- `packages/cli/src/utils/scaffold-validate.ts` (the note now at :128-:133, the hold's :118-:121) was re-read. "Both resolve to the copy shipped in `@objectstack/console`" was false while this leg was dead. It is true now, so it is not edited. One pre-existing imprecision stays as it was: `os init` reads the INVOKER's directory, so invoking it from a directory that carries its own `sdui.manifest.json` (this repository's root does) reads that file instead.
- Comment drift outside this claim, noted only:
  - `.github/workflows/lint.yml` (:899) and `scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` (:28-30, :240) still say `resolveSduiManifest()` degrades to parse-only silently. A notice has said so since #20113, and with this change a missing root artefact falls to the console copy first.
  - The header of `packages/lint/src/validate-jsx-pages.ts` still calls full manifest validation "not wired".
  - `docs/qa/platform-checklist/areas/studio-authoring.json` still describes the showcase's compiled tree as flex/div/a nodes.
- The five macOS-only `published-subpath-*` failures above come from the test comparing a `tmpdir()` path with the real path that module resolution returns. They are host-specific and pass with a real-path `TMPDIR`. Noted, not filed.
- Measurement scaffolding was all in scratch, or in this worktree's gitignored `packages/console/dist/`: a trap-removed stand-in copy of the tracked manifest (plus an `index.html` stand-in for the pack probe). `git status --porcelain` printed 0 lines after every run.
